Hubble 1.0.4

Hubble 1.0.4: show update version details

Show the installed and latest available versions when a manual update check finds no newer build. Include installed and available versions in the update prompt so users can tell exactly what Sparkle will install.

Synchronize Hubble, HubDash, service, and protocol versions at 1.0.4 for the public signed update test.
